answer.text: Mix of rental/dividend income and interest depending on REIT type

explanation.text: The Logic: ReITs are income-generating real estate vehicles that distribute earnings as dividends. Equity REITs generate rental income, mortgage REITs generate interest income, and hybrid REITs earn both, so the mix of distribution depends on the REIT type. The Trap: Single-stream views (only rent, only dividends, only interest) miss the structural variation across REIT types. Note: Distribution composition depends on whether the REIT is equity, mortgage, or hybrid.
